description: This PHP source file is part of the vtiger CRM project. It retrieves a list of Word templates from the database, processes them, and displays them using a Smarty template, specifically for the Settings module of vtiger CRM.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: A Smarty wrapper class used within vtiger CRM to render templates.

methods.name: getTranslatedString
methods.description: Retrieves the translated string for a given key in a specified module.

methods.name: return_module_language
methods.description: Returns language strings for a specific module in the current language.

methods.name: getParentTab
methods.description: Retrieves the parent tab for the current context.
